question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget be accepted as a sessions.list-backed dashboard builtin in the linked ops-widget PR, or should it wait for the broader gateway-owned per-session activity contract?
rationale: Current main lacks the dashboard surface, the linked PR is unmerged and conflicting, and the requested current-task/progress semantics may exceed the current sessions.list contract.

options.title: Keep the linked PR as the implementation path
options.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the dashboard-widget implementation once the dashboard foundation and proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open but require https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 to define the backend activity semantics before accepting the widget.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Move the remaining product discussion to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 if maintainers want fewer dashboard roadmap issue shards.

recommendation.title: Keep the linked PR as the implementation path
recommendation.body: Review and repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the dashboard-widget implementation once the dashboard foundation and proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the current Control UI plugin-tab seam, session list projection, and bundled dashboard product direction where steipete has the strongest current-main history signal.
